NARRATOR.say: in a deep, warm, cinematic documentary narrator voice, with dramatic pauses

lines.text: Did you know…? Over 2,000 years ago, Jesus Christ did something that seemed impossible.
One night, his disciples were struggling in a boat during a powerful storm.
Suddenly… they saw someone walking towards them… ON THE WATER!
Peter even stepped out of the boat and walked towards Him. But when Peter became afraid of the storm, he began to sink.
Jesus immediately reached out and saved him.
This incredible event is recorded in Matthew chapter 14.
But here's the question… Would you have stepped out of that boat?
